QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, the installed functions wrap the heap in a mutex (`:541-563`). ... `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` ... installs its own pair through the runtime setter (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:572-575`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that with MBEDTLS_THREADING_C the installed functions use a mutex. It never says the mutexed pair or the plain pair is chosen at compile time inside the init function, and it never mentions the plain pair as the alternative.
